biggest_catch: The 20% is capped at $100 and the offer is savings on a planned Lowe's purchase — not cash. The card's purchase APR is 31.99% (36.99% penalty APR), so carrying any balance past the due date quickly costs more than the $100 discount, and applying triggers a hard credit inquiry.
catches: Savings, not income: the $100 maximum is a discount on planned Lowe's spending only — never buy extra just to chase the discount.

$0 annual fee, so the fee math is clean, but the 31.99% purchase APR (36.99% penalty APR if you pay late, per the June 2026 Synchrony account agreement) wipes out the $100 discount fast if you carry a balance.
Applying for the card is a hard inquiry on your credit report — only worth it if you were already planning a $500+ Lowe's purchase.
Subject to credit approval; not everyone is approved. In-store accounts must ask the cashier to apply the barcode discount at time of purchase — it is not automatic.

Many exclusions: services, rentals, installation/delivery/assembly fees, taxes, gift cards, previous sales, Weber/Kichler/Miele products, contractor/volume pricing programs, military and employee discounts, and the 5% Everyday discount can't be stacked (the greater of the two applies).
Cannot be combined with special financing offers; one coupon per new account, non-transferable, not redeemable for cash.
Terms can be altered or discontinued at any time by Lowe's.

steps: Apply for a new MyLowe's Rewards Credit Card (in-store, online, or via text/QR) and get approved.
Make a qualifying purchase on the new account — plan a $500+ purchase to reach the full $100 maximum (20% of $500).
In-store: ask the cashier to apply the 20% barcode discount at the time of purchase (not automatic). Online/text/QR: use the one-time coupon/promotional code you receive.
Pay the statement balance in full by the due date so the 31.99% APR never applies.
timing: One-time discount applied at the time of the first qualifying purchase on the new account; ongoing offer, no stated end date.

when_cash_arrives: 20% off (up to $100) applied at the time of your first qualifying purchase on the newly opened MyLowe's Rewards Credit Card.
maximize: Plan a ~$500 already-planned purchase and use the new card at checkout the day you open it for the full $100 value.

speed_history.rationale: Official Lowe's credit terms: the discount applies at the time of the first qualifying purchase on the new account — value realized same day at checkout.
